title: Can ‘eSUV’ e-bikes really go from trail to town?
summary: ﻿Yes, if it’s Amflow’s TL Carbon — but expect compromises. The Amflow TL Carbon is built upon the same Avinox drive system that threw the electric mountain bike (eMTB) industry into a tizzy two years ago.
